stories.title: Follow live: Arizona giving No. 2 Utah all it can handle in tight Big 12 matchup
Manning shows 'competitive spirit,' shakes off 3 INTs to lead Texas' comeback over LSU
stories.summary: Arch Manning found Raleek Brown for a 4-yard touchdown pass along the left sideline with 3 seconds left, and Texas escaped Tiger Stadium with a victory over LSU on Saturday night.

stories.title: Oklahoma AD rips Ole Miss, SEC for Sunday game; Rebels defend travel efforts
stories.summary: Oklahoma AD Roger Denny ripped the SEC and Ole Miss for the "inexplicable" decision to move its game to Sunday, while the Rebels defended their travel efforts.

stories.title: Gane taken to brink by game Hokit, edges out decision in UFC title slugfest
stories.summary: Ciryl Gane got all he could handle from Josh Hokit in a five-round slugfest, but took command late to defend his heavyweight title Saturday night at UFC 334.

stories.title: Harrison spoils Nunes' return, submits ex-champion to retain UFC crown
stories.summary: Kayla Harrison scored the biggest victory of her career Saturday, submitting former champion Amanda Nunes by rear-naked choke in Round 4 to retain her title at UFC 334.
